name: NVIDIA Profile Presets
description: Applies a selected NVIDIA global driver preset, including Competitive, Balanced, Quality, or Restore Defaults.

description_i18n.en: Applies a selected NVIDIA global driver preset, including Competitive, Balanced, Quality, or Restore Defaults.
description_i18n.de: Wendet ein ausgewähltes globales NVIDIA-Treiber-Preset an: Competitive, Balanced, Quality oder Restore Defaults.
description_i18n.fr: Applique un profil de pilote NVIDIA global pour optimiser les jeux ou le rendu et restaurer les paramètres d'usine.

technical_details: Executes the nvidia-profile-helper utility against the global NVIDIA base profile. Competitive uses Fortnite-oriented public NVAPI settings, leaves the driver frame limiter and low-latency mode off for in-game control, and does not change DSR factors or the preferred OpenGL GPU because no reviewed portable mapping is available.
